invalid-repository.message: The selected repository could not be used. Correct the repository selection.

invalid-request.message: A search field or filter is invalid. Correct the request before retrying.

missing-index.message: No usable index was found for this request. Inspect the selected index before changing it.

missing-capability.message: A requested capability is unavailable. Inspect setup or tooling readiness.

unsupported-format.message: The selected index format is unsupported. Inspect its health and compatibility.

timeout.message: The search did not finish within its deadline. Narrow the request or retry explicitly.

cancelled.message: The request was cancelled. No successful search response was admitted.

resource-pending.message: Original resources have not finished cleanup. Check their status before retrying.

stale-request.message: The request or its selected scope changed. Review it and submit a new request.

incomplete-response.message: The search returned an incomplete or unsupported response. No new response page was admitted.

permission-denied.message: The selected resource could not be accessed. Review the repository and access configuration.

resource-missing.message: A requested repository or indexed resource was not found. Review the selection.

native-failure.message: The search process ended unexpectedly. Keep the diagnostic identifier and inspect readiness.

unknown.message: The search could not complete. Use the diagnostic identifier without exposing private request details.
